insights: Strongly centered composition with symmetric hero layout—headline, CTAs, and media all centered on vertical axis, creating formal balance and focus
Card-based modular system with consistent rounded corners (6-10px), subtle shadows, and layered depth effects (drop shadows, overlapping elements) to create tactile hierarchy
Generous breathing room between sections (80-160px vertical spacing) creates a calm, spacious rhythm; whitespace is the primary separator rather than graphical dividers
Sticky navigation remains visible on scroll, maintaining wayfinding; logo wall uses sticky positioning at certain breakpoints to anchor scrolling experience
Accent illustrations (agents, people peeking) add playful asymmetry to otherwise symmetric centered layouts, breaking grid rigidity without disrupting balance
